channel.title: Apparel and textiles: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the apparel and textiles sector.

item.title: HYUNGJI Innovation and Creative Company: Hyungji I&C filed for an injunction in Seoul Southern District Court to suspend Korea Exchange's delisting and administrative issue designation decisions.
Great New wave Coming: GnCo decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 1,113,172 new common shares at KRW 2,695 each, to repay convertible bond debt.
TBH Global: TBH Global reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 36.9bn, up 4.0% YoY, with an operating loss of KRW 0.3bn.
Metalabs: Metalabs reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 40.7bn and operating profit of KRW 1.7bn, a swing from a year-earlier loss.
Metalabs: Metalabs completed its small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary Meta S&C on November 1, 2026, issuing no new shares.
